documents.title: Brent sensitivity: $2.1B revenue per $1/bbl
documents.source_ref: Meridian Corporate Planning — price deck model
documents.excerpt: Every $1/bbl Brent move changes FY2026 revenue by about $2.1B and net income by about $0.9B after the price-linked royalty tier and 46% effective tax.

documents.title: Q3 forecast $19B below the $492B budget
documents.excerpt: Lower realized prices across the chain drive the gap: crude fields −$8.3B, refining −$7.2B, gas −$1.2B and trading −$2.7B; volumes are broadly on plan.

documents.title: Gas expansion is the growth engine
documents.source_ref: Meridian Gas Co. — Al-Rimal program review
documents.excerpt: Non-Associated Gas Fields revenue is budgeted 3 points above group growth as the Al-Rimal unconventional program ramps and frees crude for export.

documents.title: Refining margin squeeze at international JVs
documents.excerpt: International Refining JVs run at 68% cost of sales; a $2/bbl drop in the Singapore complex margin costs about $2B of EBITDA.

documents.title: Dividend exceeds free cash flow
documents.excerpt: The FY2026 budget dividend of $83.7B exceeds free cash flow of $60.3B after $51.2B capex; the $23B gap is funded from cash and debt and widens to about $35B at $60 Brent.
